Nia Gomez: Heads up - PO 2601 inbound to FRA flagged for sensor mismatch. 10x A800s on AWB FRA-222333 held by customs.
Atlas Supply Rep: We see the alert. Batch had mixed sensor firmware; carrier flagged temp variance. Pulling sensor logs now.
Paul - Logistics: ETA on logs? we have reserved nodes scheduled for EU dedicated customers.
Atlas Supply Rep: Can upload logs within 6h. Options: 1) split-ship 5 matched units from DE pool tomorrow (air) — expedited fee EUR 2.8k/unit; 2) depot audit in FRA (~3-5d) with vendor covering depot labor if you accept split.
Ravi K.: If we accept split, who covers FRA storage after 48h? carrier quoted EUR 220/day.
Atlas Supply Rep: Vendor will cover depot handling and storage for the first 7 days if you accept split shipment. Customs broker fees per contract remain on receiver, but we'll issue freight credit.
FinanceBot: Note: customs broker fees to date EUR 510. Add to dispute queue.
Nia Gomez: Need serial continuity for billing and audits. vendor must provide temp serial mapping and signed handoff doc at delivery.
Paul - Logistics: Decision needed: Accept 5 replacements + vendor covers 7d storage and depot handling? We'll reassign 3 canary nodes to US temporarily.
Ravi K.: Approve on condition vendor supplies sensor logs and photos within 8h and immediate ledger update for temp serials.
Atlas Supply Rep: Confirmed. Replacements AWB: DE-999-000 ETA 05:30 UTC tomorrow. Upload logs/photos and signed handoff within 8h of arrival. Credit note for expedited freight to follow.
Paul - Logistics: tagging runbooks: eu-alloc-fallback + rma-trace. I'll start pool reassignments.
Nia Gomez: Approved. Postmortem: procurement add manifest sensor-firmware validation before shipment. :memo:
